Text.Text: The Bastion Training Engine is silent, and the halls under that ruin can be walked without an escort. You kept your companions standing and opened the way for the ones behind you. That is what a Guardian Master is. I have nothing left to correct in you.
I can only take someone who has mastered the lightsaber. When the blade stops being something you have to think about, come back, and we will talk about the work on Hutlar.

The students I took into the hidden halls on Hutlar are safe here, every one of them. The halls are not. Beneath a concrete ruin in the Cloning Test Site lie the Jedi Trial Halls, a refuge built before the Mandalorians came, and its training droids now treat anyone inside as an intruder. Start near the entrance. Disable six Guardian Patrol Droids and recover the Guardian Master Enclave Trial Slate. It recorded every shutdown that failed.

Take this key. It opens the sealed blast door in the east wall of the concrete ruin at the north end of the Cloning Test Site on Hutlar, just south of the big pipe. The Trial Halls lie below. Six patrol droids, and the trial slate. Bring it back to me here in Anchorhead.

A guardian stands between harm and the people behind him. The form is built on that: hold your ground, cover the one beside you, and never mistake a perfect guard over an empty doorway for duty. The droids only remember the first part.

Land at the Hutlar Outpost and take the north exit onto the Qion Tundra. Go north-west into the Qion Valley, then west into the Cloning Test Site. A concrete ruin stands at its north end. The sealed blast door is in the ruin's east wall, just south of the big pipe that runs out of it. I stay because the students sheltering here in the South District are still mine to keep.

Training droids. They were built to press a student hard and stop short of harm. Their threat recognition has failed, and the stopping no longer happens. No students remain inside. You are fighting machines, not people.
Six Guardian Patrol Droids, and the trial slate. The blast door is in the east wall of the concrete ruin at the north end of the Cloning Test Site on Hutlar, just south of the big pipe.
You have the trial slate. Let me see it.
The slate records the shutdown failures. The next controller is deeper inside.
The first droids are down, but their timing controller still drives the next set. Disable five Guardian Bulwark Droids deeper in the Trial Halls and recover the Guardian Master Kyber Focus Shard.
Five Guardian Bulwark Droids, deeper in the Trial Halls. Bring back the focus shard.
The next units react to each other. Bait one attack, move out of its partner's line, then close before their routines synchronize again.
The focus shard belongs to the training array. It coordinates the practice emitters; bring it back so I can trace the fault.
Past the halls you already cleared, deeper in. Keep your way back to the entrance open. A guardian always knows where the door is.
Five Guardian Bulwark Droids, deeper in the Trial Halls. Bring back the focus shard.
You brought the focus shard. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The focus shard is secure. We can now work on the sealed gate.

One gate runs on its own controller, and the remote shutdown cannot reach it. A Guardian Gatekeeper Droid holds the eastern halls, north of the passage you enter by. Disable it and recover the Guardian Master Fractured Trial Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
The Guardian Gatekeeper Droid holds the eastern halls, north of the passage. Disable it and bring back the broken sigil. Do not go without two allies.
The Guardian Gatekeeper Droid is a reinforced gate-control construct. Its shutdown channel is broken, so the chassis has to be disabled by hand.
The sigil is the damaged authorization plate from that gate. With it, we can restore the lock without waking its defender again.
Three fighters can divide its attention and cover a retreat. This is damaged equipment operating at lethal output; do not treat it as a practice duel.
The Guardian Gatekeeper Droid still holds the eastern halls. Disable it and bring back the broken sigil. Do not go without two allies.
You brought the sigil. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The gate is clear. The sigil will let us identify the remaining control seals.
The gate is open, but four linked Guardian Shield Droids still guard the network's control systems. Disable all four and recover the Guardian Master Council Trial Chit.
Four Guardian Shield Droids guard the control systems in the Trial Halls. Disable them and bring back the trial chit.
The chit authorizes service access to the training network. With it, I can reach the control systems and lock the damaged routines down.
The four constructs share targeting data. Break their formation before they can concentrate every attack on one of you.
Their routines were built from recorded exercises. They can be rebuilt with proper safeguards once you have made the wing safe.
Four Guardian Shield Droids still guard the control systems in the Trial Halls. Disable them and bring back the trial chit.
You brought the trial chit. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The chit is secure. One chamber remains.

Only the central training engine remains, and while it runs it can restart every damaged routine. The Bastion Training Engine waits in the Saber Trial Chamber, through the door at the north end of the halls. Disable it. Bring at least two allies.
The Bastion Training Engine waits in the Saber Trial Chamber at the north end of the Trial Halls. Go in together, and come out together.
The Bastion Training Engine coordinates this branch of the training network. Its adaptive combat routines let it direct several attackers at once.
Stay close enough to help each other without offering it one easy line of attack. Trade the pressure between you and keep the escape route open.
The halls stay sealed until the faulty controllers are replaced and every shutdown is tested. Only then does any student go back. Not before.
The Bastion Training Engine still waits in the Saber Trial Chamber at the north end of the Trial Halls. Take at least two allies.
The Bastion Training Engine is down. Tell me what happened.

The Bastion Training Engine has stopped transmitting. The halls can be repaired without another evacuation, and the students can go home. You protected your companions and opened a way through. That is the whole of what I teach.

The students who fled those halls are sheltering here in Anchorhead's South District, on Tatooine, where no faction can lay claim to them, and I will not leave them to strangers. So the training comes to me. The droids are still in the hidden Jedi Trial Halls beneath a ruin in the Cloning Test Site on Hutlar. Go there, and bring the slate back to me here.
Go over the first assignment.
I will clear the first halls.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered slate.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
What should I know before going deeper?
What is the focus shard?
Where is the next group?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Explain the gate assignment again.
I will bring two allies and clear the breach.
What guards the gate?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The gate is clear. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four targets again.
I will disable the shield droids.
What does the trial chit do?
How do they work together?
Can the machines be repaired?
I need to rest first.
Here is the trial chit.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
How should we fight it?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The training engine is down. We all made it out.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
